verdicts.reason: In both candidates the patterned background is shrunk into a narrow strip in the middle, and the left and right thirds of the banner are left as empty white space, so this is a shrink, not a rearrangement for the wide format. The 'Award-Winning Architecture' text is tiny in both. In A, the dark panel covers almost all of the gold and grey brush pattern, so the original's look is mostly lost. B shows more of the pattern around a smaller panel, so it keeps the feel slightly better, but its text is just as small.
